reference_sql:
SELECT s.city, SUM(ol.quantity) AS units
FROM order_lines ol
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = ol.order_id
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10'
GROUP BY s.city
alternatives: SELECT s.city, SUM(ol.quantity) AS units FROM stores s JOIN orders o ON o.store_id = s.store_id JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = o.order_id WHERE CAST(o.order_ts AS DATE) BETWEEN DATE '2025-03-03' AND DATE '2025-03-09' GROUP BY s.city

WITH week_orders AS (SELECT order_id, store_id FROM orders WHERE order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03' AND order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10') SELECT s.city, SUM(ol.quantity) AS units FROM week_orders w JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = w.order_id JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = w.store_id GROUP BY s.city

other_way.sql: WITH week_orders AS (SELECT order_id, store_id FROM orders WHERE order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03' AND order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10') SELECT s.city, SUM(ol.quantity) AS units FROM week_orders w JOIN order_lines ol ON ol.order_id = w.order_id JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = w.store_id GROUP BY s.city
other_way.tradeoff: Picking the week's orders in a CTE first keeps each join small, but it adds a step to read.

solver.query:
SELECT s.city, SUM(l.quantity) AS units
FROM order_lines l
JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = l.order_id
JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = o.store_id
WHERE o.order_ts >= TIMESTAMP '2025-03-03 00:00:00' AND o.order_ts < TIMESTAMP '2025-03-10 00:00:00'
GROUP BY s.city
